concepts.title: Types of Motion
concepts.definition: The classification of how an object moves, which can indeed be along a straight path, in a circular loop, or repeating periodically over regular intervals.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Motion can be linear, circular, or oscillatory depending on the path traced by the moving body.
question_patterns: classify the motion of the hands of an athlete in a race
what type of motion is shown by a pendulum
classify the motion of a train on a straight bridge
identify the type of motion for a child on a swing
what do you understand by types of motion

solution_steps.explain: Determine if the object moves along a straight line (rectilinear), in a circle (circular), or back and forth about a mean position (oscillatory/periodic).

solution_steps.action: Match the path to a motion category
solution_steps.explain: Compare the observed path against the three categories: rectilinear (straight line), circular (closed loop around a center), or oscillatory (repeating back-and-forth about a fixed point).
Confirm the chosen category by citing the defining feature of that motion type, ensuring the answer aligns with the key_idea that motion type depends on the path traced.

concepts.title: Average Speed
concepts.definition: The total distance covered by a moving object divided by the total duration of time taken to cover that distance.
concepts.key_idea: Speed represents the speed with which distance is covered per unit of time.
question_patterns: calculate the speed of the train
find the average speed of a car covering a distance of
what is the speed of an object that travels
how fast is a vehicle moving if it covers
find the required value in a average speed problem

solution_steps.action: Identify the given distance and time values
solution_steps.explain: Extract the total distance covered and the total time taken from the problem statement, ensuring both are in compatible units.
Divide the total distance covered by the total time taken.

solution_steps.action: Express the result with proper units
solution_steps.explain: Attach the correct unit (m/s or km/h) to the computed value and verify it is reasonable for the given scenario.

concepts.title: Uniform and Non-Uniform Motion
concepts.definition: Uniform motion occurs when an object travels along a straight line at a constant speed, whereas non-uniform motion occurs when its speed changes over time.
concepts.formula: concept method; no single closed formula
concepts.key_idea: Constant speed along a straight line signifies uniform motion, while varying speed signifies non-uniform motion.
question_patterns: distinguish between uniform and non-uniform motion
is a car moving with changing speed in uniform motion
what does a straight line distance-time graph indicate about motion
how does uniform and non-uniform motion work
list the main features of uniform and non-uniform motion

solution_steps.explain: If the speed remains constant, the motion is uniform. If the speed varies, the motion is non-uniform.
A straight line on the distance-time graph indicates uniform motion, while a curved or non-linear graph indicates non-uniform motion.
Combine the speed consistency check and graph analysis to classify the motion as uniform or non-uniform, citing the key_idea that constant speed along a straight line means uniform motion.

concepts.title: Time Period of a Simple Pendulum
concepts.definition: The duration of time required by a simple pendulum to complete one full back-and-forth oscillation.
concepts.key_idea: The time period is determined by dividing the total measured time by the total number of oscillations completed.
question_patterns: calculate the time period of the pendulum
what is the time period if a pendulum takes
find the time taken for one oscillation of a pendulum
find the required value in a time period of a simple pendulum problem
solve a numerical on time period of a simple pendulum

solution_steps.action: Identify the total time and number of oscillations
solution_steps.explain: Extract the total measured time and the count of complete oscillations from the problem statement.
Divide the total time taken by the number of oscillations completed.

solution_steps.action: Express the time period with units
solution_steps.explain: State the result in seconds (s) per oscillation and confirm it is consistent with the definition of one full back-and-forth swing.

concepts.title: Distance Covered
concepts.definition: The total length of path traversed by an object moving at a given speed over a specific interval of time.
concepts.key_idea: Distance is the speed of the object multiplied by the time it travels.
question_patterns: calculate the distance between
how far does a car travel in
find the distance covered by a bicycle moving at
calculate distance covered for the given values
find the required value in a distance covered problem

solution_steps.action: Identify the speed and time values
solution_steps.explain: Extract the object's speed and the travel time from the problem, converting units so both are compatible (e.g., m/s with seconds, or km/h with hours).
Multiply the speed by the time taken.

solution_steps.action: Express the distance with proper units
solution_steps.explain: State the result in the appropriate distance unit (meters or kilometers) and verify it matches the units used for speed and time.

concepts.title: Time Taken
concepts.definition: The duration required for an object to cover a specific distance while moving at a constant speed.
concepts.key_idea: Time taken is calculated by dividing the total distance by the constant speed of travel.
question_patterns: how much time does a train take to cover
calculate the time taken to travel
find the time duration for a journey of
solve a numerical on time taken
compute the answer step by step for time taken

solution_steps.action: Identify the distance and speed values
solution_steps.explain: Extract the total distance to be covered and the constant speed of travel from the problem, ensuring compatible units.
Divide the distance by the speed.

solution_steps.action: Express the time with proper units
solution_steps.explain: State the result in the appropriate time unit (seconds, minutes, or hours) and verify it is consistent with the units of distance and speed.

concepts.title: Speed Unit Conversion
concepts.definition: The process of converting a speed value from kilometers per hour (km/h) to meters per second (m/s) or vice versa.
concepts.key_idea: To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 1000 and divide by 3600 (or multiply by 5/18).
question_patterns: convert speed from km/h to m/s
express the speed in m/s
what is the speed in meters per second
work out the value using speed unit conversion
calculate speed unit conversion for the given values

solution_steps.explain: Extract the given speed value in kilometers per hour that needs to be converted to meters per second.
Multiply the speed in km/h by 1000 to convert kilometers to meters, and divide by 3600 to convert hours to seconds.
Simplify the fraction (equivalent to multiplying by 5/18) and state the final speed in m/s, confirming the conversion is correct.

concepts.title: Odometer Distance and Speed
concepts.definition: Calculating the distance traveled using the difference between final and initial odometer readings, and subsequently finding the speed.
concepts.key_idea: The odometer measures cumulative distance; subtracting the initial reading from the final reading gives the trip's distance.
question_patterns: calculate the distance moved using odometer readings
find the speed of the car from odometer readings
what is the distance covered if the odometer reading changes from
work out the value using odometer distance and speed
calculate odometer distance and speed for the given values

solution_steps.explain: Subtract the initial odometer reading from the final odometer reading.
Divide the calculated distance by the elapsed time.

solution_steps.action: Express the speed with proper units
solution_steps.explain: State the speed in the appropriate unit (km/min or km/h) based on the time unit used, and verify the result is reasonable for a vehicle trip.
